name: runlater
description: Schedule HTTP requests from your agent: call a public URL once at an exact time or on a cron schedule, with retries and a log of every run. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1. Paid plans from $15/mo with a 14-day trial.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in to RunLater (dynamic client registration, no key needed). Scheduling needs a paid plan (from $15/mo, 14-day trial); until then tools reply with a setup link.

tools.name: schedule_get_request
tools.description: Schedule a GET to a public URL once at an exact time or on a cron schedule.

tools.name: schedule_send_request
tools.description: Schedule a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE with an optional body, once or on cron.

tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: List scheduled requests with status and next run time.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Get one schedule with its recent runs: status code, duration, error and response preview.

tools.name: pause_schedule
tools.description: Pause a schedule until it is resumed.

tools.name: run_now
tools.description: Send a scheduled request once, right now, and return the status code and response.

tools.name: delete_schedule
tools.description: Delete a scheduled request for good.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Show the workspace's limits and usage this month.
